title: Pricing Assist Listing Age Adjustment — Roamhaven Listings Decision Card
content:
# Pricing Assist Listing Age Adjustment

*Decision card for Roamhaven Listings.*

The listing age adjustment is a Pricing Assist adjustment, a fraction of the all-in night, worked out on the day of the request from the listing's first listed date — the date it was first published.

| Whole months from the first listed date to the day of the request | Listing age adjustment |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 | -0.03, a reduction |
| at least 12 and fewer than 24 | -0.02, a reduction |
| 24 or more | none |

## Edge readings (hypothetical listings, request on 2026-06-15)

| First listed date | Whole months back | Listing age adjustment |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-06-16 | 11 | -0.03 |
| 2025-06-15 | 12 | -0.02 |
| 2024-06-16 | 23 | -0.02 |
| 2024-06-15 | 24 | none |
